schemes.name: Rythu Bandhu (Farmers Investment Support Scheme)
schemes.description: Direct agricultural investment incentive of ₹10,000 per acre per year (₹5,000/acre/season) credited straight to patta-holding farmers' bank accounts for crop inputs.

schemes.name: Dalit Bandhu Scheme
schemes.description: One-time direct financial grant of ₹10,00,000 per eligible Dalit family to establish self-employment businesses without any bank loan or mortgage burden.

schemes.name: Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation & Major Irrigation Outlays
schemes.department: Irrigation and Command Area Development Department
schemes.description: World's largest multi-stage lift irrigation system diverting Godavari waters to irrigate over 45 lakh acres and filling reservoirs across parched Telangana plateaus.

schemes.name: 24x7 Free Agriculture Electricity Supply
schemes.description: Uninterrupted free three-phase 24-hour agricultural power supply to over 27.5 lakh pump sets across all agricultural districts.

schemes.name: Aasara Social Safety Net Pensions
schemes.department: Panchayat Raj and Rural Development Department
schemes.description: Monthly direct benefit transfer welfare pensions of ₹2,016 for senior citizens, widows, beedi workers, weavers, and ₹3,016 for differently abled citizens.

schemes.name: Mission Bhagiratha (Safe Tap Drinking Water to Every Household)
schemes.department: Panchayat Raj and Rural Development Department
schemes.description: Network of surface water pipelines and water treatment plants ensuring 100 lpcd safe fluorosis-free tap water to every habitation in rural and urban Telangana.

schemes.name: Mana Ooru - Mana Badi / Mana Basti - Mana Badi
schemes.description: Holistic revamping and modernization of all 26,065 government and local body schools with 12 basic infrastructure components including English medium education.

schemes.name: Double Bedroom (2BHK) Dignity Housing Programme
schemes.description: Fully state-subsidized dignified 2BHK pucca houses constructed and allotted completely free of cost to economically weaker section families.

schemes.name: Kalyana Lakshmi & Shaadi Mubarak
schemes.description: Financial assistance of ₹1,00,116 given directly to the mother of unmarried girls at the time of marriage to alleviate child marriages and financial hardship.

schemes.name: Rythu Bima (Farmers Life Insurance Scheme)
schemes.description: Comprehensive ₹5,00,000 life insurance policy with LIC covering all farmers aged 18-59 with premium entirely paid by the State Government, settled within 10 days.

schemes.name: KCR Kit & KCR Nutrition Poshan Kit
schemes.department: Health, Medical and Family Welfare Department
schemes.description: Financial incentive of up to ₹13,000 for institutional deliveries in government hospitals along with a 16-item care kit for newborn and mother.

schemes.name: Sheep Distribution & Fisheries Enhancement Scheme
schemes.description: Subsidized 20+1 sheep unit distribution for Kuruma and Yadava communities, and free fish seed replenishment across 25,000+ irrigation tanks.
